name: pas
description: PAS - PowerAgent Store. Apps for PowerAgent: pages the dashboard can embed, with optional server code.

apps.name: routines
apps.label: Routines
apps.description: Scheduled and on-demand jobs: team meetings, mail summaries, weather, and anything else on a timer or an event trigger, with a routine maker.
apps.author: magicalmutation-coder

apps.name: avatar-pack
apps.label: Extra Avatars
apps.description: Ten more avatars: yeti, unicorn, mermaid, kraken, paratrooper, tanker, grenadier, battle mech, centaur and minotaur. Installing copies them into assets\avatars\ so they appear in the avatar picker.
apps.author: magicalmutation-coder

apps.name: scicalc
apps.label: Scientific Calculator
apps.description: A calculator with trig (deg/rad), logs, powers, factorial, constants and a memory, plus a working-out line so you can check the order of operations.
apps.author: magicalmutation-coder
